experiment_data.hypothesis: Additive random control: r = r_exec·(1+0.3·random). 隔离 ISR structural signal vs variance regularization. 若 ISR > random > exec-only → signal+regularization 均贡献; 若 ISR > random ≈ exec-only → ISR signal 是关键; 若 ISR ≈ random → ISR 无结构价值。

experiment_data.notes: Eval结果: PR=0.48, mean_ISR=0.0453, proved_only_ISR=0.0943, mean_components=9.56 (3+比例100%, 无tautological collapse). 但33%已证明样本ISR=0 (n_necessary=0, conclusion trivially provable). 与plan013的不同failure mode: additive random防止了2-component坍缩, 但模型转向生成复杂但无用的formalization (多premises但conclusion不依赖任何premise). Variance regularization不足以产生genuine proofs.
